files.agent-runtime/schemas.ts: A schema file: Zod schemas for agent messages, runs, operations, terminal reasons, costs and snapshots with one mapping helper; size is the vocabulary.
files.declaration/declaration.ts: A schema file: one Zod schema per project-declaration record (paths, listeners, roles, builds, env) with refinements; size is the vocabulary.
files.server/types.ts: Type vocabulary only: handler contexts, method/service defs, hooks, raw routes, logging and handler config; no runtime code, size is the surface area of the server API.

scriptFiles.packages/core/scripts/consumer-lane/opti: One matrix of optional-peer install and bundle scenarios run as a single lane; it should split by scenario family.
scriptFiles.packages/core/scripts/consumer-lane/fixt: The full-surface consumer fixture: one application that imports every public entrypoint so the lane type-checks them together.
A consumer fixture that exercises streaming subscriptions end to end; ten lines over the limit.
The consumer-lane runner: pack, install, type-check and execute every fixture; it should split into pack, install and run steps.
scriptFiles.packages/core/scripts/node-smoke.mjs: The Node smoke lane: one script that loads every built entrypoint under Node; it should split by entrypoint family.
scriptFiles.scripts/gen-llms.ts: The llms bundle generator: parsing, rendering and checking of every public entrypoint in one script; it should split by phase.
scriptFiles.scripts/lane-processes.test.ts: Tests of the lane process supervisor; they share one fixture process and should split by behaviour next to lane-processes.ts.
scriptFiles.scripts/lane-processes.ts: The lane process supervisor: spawn, readiness, shutdown and reporting of lane children; seven lines over the limit.
scriptFiles.scripts/starter-lane.ts: The starter lane runner: scaffold, install, check, build and serve in one script; it should split by phase.
